# Instructions for hooks

These files support local developer workflow or repository hooks.

## Guidance
- Keep behavior predictable and developer-friendly.
- Avoid introducing destructive actions.
- Explain when a change affects local commit or validation behavior.
- Prefer clarity and maintainability over clever scripting.

## Review focus
- developer workflow impact
- script safety
- portability
- clear error handling
